decision.explanation: The question asks for the main character in the video game 'Who Framed Roger Rabbit'. The source documents describe two distinct versions of this game. Document 1 (D1S3) states that in the 1988 MS-DOS/Amiga/etc. version, 'The player controls Roger Rabbit'. Document 2 (D2S5) states that in the 1989 NES version, 'The player controls private detective Eddie Valiant'. Since both characters are explicitly identified as the controlled entity (the protagonist/main character) in their respective versions of the game mentioned in the sources, both are valid answers. The R5 list correctly includes both.
